requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The Out-Of-Box Experience (OOBE) on 123.hp.com must present only one unique product name/reference for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series to the customer, to minimize user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must be able to print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media, meeting the intervention specification for different media types and climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must function properly and without hardware failure when placed and used on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess whether the printer experiences any functional failure when tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing, as per CISS product evaluation protocol.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and function without issues when printing while placed on a moving trolley.
